install.title: Freestanding or built-in?
install.help: A built-in appliance is hidden behind a kitchen cabinet door with the same front as the cabinets. A freestanding appliance is fully visible and can be moved.

size.title: How tall should it be?
size.why: The size is the appliance's height. Check the space under a wall cabinet or a sloping ceiling.

h54.label: ~54 cm
h54.sublabel: mini, on a counter or shelf

niche.title: How tall is the niche?
niche.why: The wrong niche height is the most common reason built-in fridges are returned. The size is usually in the kitchen plan or inside the cabinet.

doors.title: How many doors?
doors.why: Two doors mean a separate freezer with its own temperature.

one.label: One door
one.sublabel: no freezer or a small compartment

hinge.title: How is the cabinet door attached?
hinge.why: A built-in fridge has to fit the cabinet door you already have.
hinge.help: Open the cabinet door: if it is screwed straight onto the fridge door, it is “door-on-door”. If the door is joined to a rail it slides along, it is “sliding”.

fixed.label: Door-on-door
fixed.sublabel: the cabinet door is screwed to the fridge door

sliding.label: Sliding
sliding.sublabel: the cabinet door slides along a rail

household.title: How many people are in your household?
household.why: The recommended capacity depends on it. A fridge that is too small is the most common complaint after buying.

What kind of shaver are you looking for?
type.help: Rotary heads follow the contours of the face in circular movements and handle longer stubble well. A foil shaver shaves in straight strokes and usually shaves closer to the skin. A hybrid (for example OneBlade) does not shave as smoothly, but it also trims the beard and shapes edges.

rotary.sublabel: follows the face, good for a thick beard

foil.sublabel: straight strokes, a very close shave

hybrid.sublabel: one blade for shaving, stubble and edges

type.help: Both adult types clean better than a manual toothbrush. A round head cleans each tooth on its own; a sonic one cleans several teeth at once with fast vibrations. Choose the one you find more comfortable.

type.title: How would you like to remove hair?
type.help: IPL suits fair to medium-dark skin and dark hair. It does not work on very fair, grey or red hair. An epilator works on all hair, but can be unpleasant at first.

epil.label: Epilator
epil.sublabel: pulls hair out by the root, smooth for 3–4 weeks

ipl.label: IPL hair removal
ipl.sublabel: light pulses, less hair over time
